headline: Water Tracker, from entry to detail
overview: Log glasses of water consumed throughout the day. Track daily and weekly intake to stay consistently hydrated.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Water Tracker — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the water intake logging interface with quick-add buttons and daily progress display.
steps.screenshotAlt: Water Tracker landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Log glasses of water with a single tap
See daily progress toward your hydration goal
View weekly intake statistics and trends
Build consistent hydration habits over time
tips: Set a daily water goal and log each glass as you drink it for the most accurate tracking.
Review your weekly stats to identify days when you tend to drink less and plan accordingly.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
